EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 1017 March 22, 1985
Subject Matter : Increasing the combat pay of officers and enlisted personnel of the Armed Forces of the Phil.
and the hazardous duty pay of the uniformed members of the Integrated National Police.
Date of Effectivity : March 22, 1985
